kept.excerpt: Steven Kwan homered to lead off the game, Tanner Bibee had seven strikeouts in 6 2/3 strong innings, and the Cleveland Guardians beat the Minnesota Twins 9-2 on Sunday to pull within a half-game of the American League Central-leading Chicago White Sox. Guardians: RHP Gavin Williams (13-7, 3.78 ERA) starts Monday for Cleveland opposite White Sox RHP Sean Burke (8-7, 3.58).
kept.relevance: Establishes Cleveland's division deficit at the cutoff and the scheduled starting pitchers for its next game against the division leader.

kept.excerpt: The White Sox, who have lost 10 of their last 14 games, begin a three-game series Monday in Cleveland. Alec Burleson hit a bases-clearing double, sparking St. Louis Cardinals to a victory over Chicago to wrap up a three-game series.
kept.publisher: Associated Press / Canadian Press via Lethbridge Herald
kept.relevance: Documents the division leader's recent losing stretch and the imminent head-to-head series that could materially change the AL Central race.

kept.excerpt: Cleveland's final homestand runs September 14–20 against the White Sox and Athletics, followed by road series against Boston and Kansas City.
kept.relevance: Identifies Cleveland's remaining opponents and home-road sequence entering the final two weeks of the division race.

kept.excerpt: DeLauter returned from a wrist sprain after missing four games. Cleveland's bullpen covered an MLB-leading 38⅔ innings over its first nine September games.
kept.relevance: Provides official evidence of an important hitter's return and heavy bullpen usage during Cleveland's stretch run.

kept.excerpt: The Guardians currently hold the AL's final wild-card spot after winning eight of their last 10 games. The Guardians also remain within striking distance of the AL Central-leading White Sox. Chase DeLauter — the team's best hitter this season — is looking healthy again.
kept.relevance: Supplies an earlier September snapshot of Cleveland's improving form, offensive health, and position relative to Chicago.

kept.excerpt: Walters, who hasn't thrown a pitch in the majors since last season, has undergone UCL repair surgery. The procedure was performed by Dr. Keith Meister in Arlington, Texas, and comes with an expected return-to-play timeline of 10-to-12 months.
kept.publisher: Akron Beacon Journal via Yahoo Sports
kept.relevance: Confirms that Andrew Walters would not be available to reinforce Cleveland's bullpen during the remaining division race.

search_notes: Frozen cutoff: 2026-09-13, inclusive. Selected six dated reports covering the latest division gap, the leading rival's form, remaining schedule, player health, and bullpen workload. Publication dates were visible in web_search source extracts; excerpts reproduce or closely condense those extracts. Built-in web_fetch failed because multiple providers were configured, and the agent-reach skill's web fallback returned RATE_LIMITED, so full-page retrieval could not be completed. Undated dynamic standings, later publications, prediction-market and betting pages, and post-cutoff developments were excluded.
